question: Which corporate learning platform has the best AI-powered coaching and personalized learning?
text:
If by “best” you mean strongest combination of AI coaching + genuinely personalized learning, I’d shortlist Docebo, Sana Learn, Degreed, and 360Learning rather than treating every AI-enabled LMS as equivalent.

Platform	AI coaching	Personalization	Particularly strong for
Docebo	Virtual coaching, AI copilot, coaching scenarios	Skills-based paths, skill-gap detection, personalized content	Large enterprises needing a full LMS + AI
Sana Learn	AI tutor/assistant and conversational learning	AI-native adaptive learning and knowledge discovery	Companies wanting an AI-first learning experience
Degreed	AI-powered coaching/development support	Strong skills intelligence, role-based pathways	Workforce transformation and internal mobility
360Learning	Adaptive AI coaching	Skills-based, organization-specific recommendations	Collaborative learning and internal expertise

Docebo is probably the most complete option if you need a mature enterprise LMS alongside the AI. Its current platform combines personalized learning paths, skills-gap analysis, AI-generated learning, coaching scenarios and an AI copilot.

Need sophisticated AI coaching + enterprise LMS: Docebo

Want the most AI-native learner experience: Sana Learn

Want skills/career personalization: Degreed

Want AI coaching grounded in internal SME knowledge: 360Learning

The important distinction is that “AI personalization” can mean very different things: course recommendations, adaptive paths, skills-gap diagnosis, conversational tutoring, or actual role-play/coaching. If you tell me your company size, whether you need an LMS or LXP, and what kind of coaching (leadership, sales, technical, etc.), I can compare the 3–4 most relevant platforms feature-by-feature, including pricing and integrations.
